score_reason: Interesting hiring trend from a well-known firm, but a small trial reported second-hand.
headline: McKinsey is testing a 10-minute interview in which some entry-level job candidates must talk to an AI playing a client.
importance_line: Graduates applying to McKinsey may face an AI client in interviews, though humans, not the AI, will score them and only hundreds are involved.
source: The Wall Street Journal, as relayed by The Verge
summary: The Wall Street Journal reports, as relayed by The Verge, that consulting firm McKinsey & Company will ask some entry-level candidates in some North American offices to hold a 10-minute conversation with an AI simulation of a client this fall. The AI will not score anyone, as humans in the room will assess how candidates handle the situation, and the WSJ says hundreds may take part.
notes: Source is the WSJ per The Verge; WSJ page not opened.
